blind.description: A straight modular interior wall segment. The front face features rich reddish-brown wood wainscoting/paneling with detailed moulding, framing, and a central diamond-studded panel on top of a low baseboard. The upper portion consists of a smooth beige/tan plastered wall topped with a continuous classical crown moulding. The back face is primarily a plain beige/tan plaster wall with a small recessed framed wooden niche or opening near the center. All geometry is solid, continuous, and clean with flat bottom sitting flush on the ground.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal rectangular strip with a protruding moulded lip running along the front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.1 times the height of the figure (around 6 ft 4 in tall) and slightly narrower than its height, roughly 4 ft wide.
